summary: Tested the automatic calculation on professional purchase invoices: ritenuta recomputed from the supplier anagrafica when an XML passive invoice is uploaded, bollo read from XML DatiBollo into prima nota, POST /ritenute/riallinea (manuali, idempotent), and the Registrazione veloce / RegistraPassivaDialog regressions. Tests ran on a TEST_T114 company with Contabilità on. Backend: new test_iteration114 passes 12 of 12; test_iteration112 (updated to the new behaviour) and test_iteration113 pass 24 of 24. Frontend: every requested flow works. One minor backend edge case was found (a single invoice can make the whole upload batch fail with 422). I fixed one stale sentence in the riallinea confirm dialog. All TEST data deleted (0 left).

minor.issue: ritenuta_da_anagrafica -> _ritenuta_upd raises HTTPException 422 when the recomputed ritenuta is >= totale. Reproduced with a supplier at ritenuta_aliquota 100 and an N4 invoice of 1000. _import_passive catches only ValueError, so the whole multi-file request returns 422 and the other valid files in the batch are not imported. The same exception would also abort riallinea partway through. Fix: catch it per document (cap the ritenuta, or skip the recompute and keep the XML value with a warning), and in riallinea count the document instead of aborting.

ui_bugs.issue: The window.confirm text still said invoices 'con ritenuta indicata nel documento' are not touched, which is wrong under the new behaviour. FIXED to 'con ritenuta modificata a mano'.

issues: Riallinea uses the native window.confirm instead of a shadcn AlertDialog.
Dates use the native date input (existing pattern).

ritenuta_xml (the value written in the XML) is not shown anywhere in PassiveDetail. If it differs from the recomputed value, showing it (e.g. 'nel file XML: 208,00 €') would help the user notice the difference.

action_items: Handle the 422 from _ritenuta_upd per document in _import_passive and ritenute_riallinea, so one invoice cannot fail the whole batch (low priority edge case).
Optional: show ritenuta_xml in PassiveDetail when it differs from the recomputed ritenuta.
critical_code_review_comments: ritenuta_da_anagrafica also runs on TD04 at upload, but riallinea only covers TD01/TD06. The behaviour is slightly inconsistent but harmless.
Upload recomputes the ritenuta when the supplier is soggetto_ritenuta or forfettario. Occasionale suppliers with soggetto_ritenuta false keep the XML value. Check this is intended.
seed_data_creation: TEST_T114 company, admin user and session, suppliers, XML passive invoices. All removed with clean() (verified 0 left).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_iteration114_ritenuta_anagrafica_bollo.py -n 0 -s (T114_KEEP=1 T114_RUN=<6 digits> keeps the data; it prints CID and TOK; UI login uses cookie session_token=TOK and localStorage fe_company_id=CID). Verified: privata with XML 208 -> 200 on 1000, ritenuta_xml 208, netto and rate 1068.80. INPS -> 208. Forfettario with XML 208 -> 0, netto 1040. A supplier that is not soggetto keeps the XML value. Bollo 2 in the total without N1 -> 30.07.019 D2 and cost 1040. With an N1 row -> no double counting. Bollo not in the total -> no line. Riallinea -> aggiornate 1, manuali 1, second run aggiornate 0. UI: the riallinea toast shows 'ritenuta modificata a mano 1'. The RegistraPassivaDialog anteprima shows 30.07.019 2,00. The regv calculator for privata gives 1268,80 / rit 200 on 1000.
